Companion to `cloud_recheck337_2026-10-01.md` §4. The full per-file CSV (`cloud_owed3_counts_2026-10-01.csv`, with file
names) is on the GitHub branch `claude/peaceful-turing-keqi5r`. Population: the 1,257 coarse-bar files with a working
stop exit = every `confirmed` row of `cloud_coarse_bar_stops_2026-10-01` (1,015) + the rows of
`cloud_recheck337_2026-10-01` whose class is intrabar_order, live_price_stop, close_based_stop or stop_and_reverse (242).
Static and approximate; see the report for the method.

## Same-bar entry and exit

Possible for every Pine file whose stop_class is intrabar_order (1,023): all 1,015 confirmed rows plus the 8 Pine
intrabar_order rows of the 337. Not possible for close-based or stop-and-reverse exits (they fill at the next open).
